_meta_.description: Declarative specification for observing, reasoning, and generating potential Field candidates from preserved Business Strategy Domains.
instruction: Treat this artifact as a generative specification rather than as generated candidate Field state.
Preserve upstream BSD definitions and boundaries without modification.
Preserve BSD-level overlap, ambiguity, duplication, and ownership paradoxes rather than resolving them prematurely.
Keep candidate state separate from this specification and materialize candidate generation results into bsd2field_candidate.json.
